issues: CC-coverage-report-001: XmlReporter constructor input requires Coverage.config/get_data and xml_file requires FileReporter.filename/relative_filename, but those protocols are not specified
CC-coverage-report-002: XmlReporter.report is declared only as an attribute while B001 implies callable full-report behavior that is never invoked
CC-coverage-report-003: no evaluator test calls report to emit a complete Cobertura document
CC-coverage-report-004: branch hit serialization and branch-rate are promised but every Analysis has has_arcs=False
CC-coverage-report-005: no oracle source files are recorded

issues.resolution: Specify the Coverage and FileReporter input protocols and correct the report callable contract.
Add an end-to-end report oracle case or narrow B001 to xml_file.
Add deterministic branch serialization/rate cases or remove branch promises.
Record immutable upstream source and adapter provenance.

notes: Line XML, package depth, skip-empty, rate, and serialization fragments are tested; the advertised full/branch report contract is not.
